//: Claude Desktop against a paperless-mcp container on your network. Claude Desktop only launches stdio servers itself, so mcp-remote bridges stdio to the container's Streamable HTTP endpoint. Requires Node.js on the machine running Claude Desktop.
//url: Replace paperless-mcp.lan:8000 with your container's host and port; the path is always /mcp.
//auth: AUTH_HEADER must be 'Bearer ' plus the PAPERLESS_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN the container was started with. It lives in env, not in args, because Claude Desktop on Windows does not escape spaces inside args.
//tls: Drop --allow-http once the endpoint is served over https.
